in_arabic.name: سكينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name of a lady mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Anfal, Ayah 47. It is derived from the Arabic root 'sakana' which means 'to be gentle, kind, soft, mild and gracious'. Thus, Sukaynah is a name of a delicate and graceful lady.
